label: input d/i (also r,f,a,0) after k/u/n earlier in sequence
explanation: Token-selective candidate unit gated by sequence context. Fires mostly when the current input is d (33% of mass, 9x lift) or i (21%, 6x), and more weakly on r, f, a, 0. It only fires on a minority of those steps, more often when k, u or n (also e, q, v, 2) appeared earlier, especially in the last 1-3 steps or at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, after <DEL>). Mass splits evenly between the original and copy phases. It never fires at t=0 or on the delimiter, and is rare for short sequences (L 3-4). The strongest activations (top quartile) are mostly on d. Predicate: d/i with k/u/n seen earlier, dev F1 0.25 (P 0.18, R 0.40, mass 0.47). Widening to {d,i,r,f,a,0} raises mass recall to 0.74 but drops precision to 0.11. The context dependence looks graded and distributed, not a clean rule.
